summary: A supplied geometric vector reconstruction of the BCSC wordmark from the cover of British Columbia Systems Corporation's 1982/83 annual report (Internet Archive microfiche). See package-README.md, Reconstruction_QA.json and review/comparison.webp.

assets.sourceFile: British Columbia Systems Corporation annual report 1982/83
assets.dateNote: Documented in use on the 1982/83 annual report, whose minister’s letter is dated 29 June 1983; the designer, adoption date and period of use are unconfirmed.
assets.label: BC Systems — BCSC wordmark, 1982/83 annual report (reconstruction)
assets.notes: BCSC in heavy, squared italic capitals with offset counters, white on the black cover of the 1982/83 annual report. Designer and adoption date unconfirmed.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied geometric reconstruction, not original artwork: B, C and S built upright from straight edges and short corner joins, then given one 30° italic shear, with the B’s offset counters, the C’s middle elbow and the S’s contrast kept, and spacing measured against the cover scan (about 95% overlap). The cover’s slight tilt is treated as scan distortion. The typeface is not identified. The cover scan is kept as a download.
